explanation: The characteristic polynomial is λ²−8λ+52, so the eigenvalues are 4±6i. Since C is a rotation-scaling matrix, (a+ib,c+id)ᵀ is an eigenvector for one of these eigenvalues. The first row gives 3(c+id)=(7−λ)(a+ib). Taking squared magnitudes yields 9(c²+d²)=45(a²+b²), so the requested ratio is 1/5.
